output.summary: Tropical and subtropical vine native from the tropical and subtropical Old World to the South Pacific. Its hollow, oblong fruit has a distinctive warty exterior and bitter flesh. Green or early-yellow fruit is generally cooked, while young shoots and leaves are eaten as greens; ripe fruit and mature seeds are toxic.
output.edibilityNote: Green or early-yellow fruit is cooked; young shoots and leaves are greens. Sweet red ripe pith is eaten raw, but ripe fruit and mature seeds are toxic.
